operations.name: signIn
operations.label: Sign in to Jira
operations.description: Checks a pasted scoped Atlassian API token with the email and site it belongs to, and signs in to Jira with it.

email.description: The email of the Atlassian account the token belongs to.

site.description: The Atlassian site, such as your-team.atlassian.net.

operations.name: addSite
operations.label: Add a Jira site
operations.description: Finds an Atlassian site by its address and uses it for the Project.

site.description: The Atlassian site, such as your-team.atlassian.net.

operations.name: chooseSite
operations.label: Choose a Project's Jira site
operations.description: Choose which Atlassian site a Project's Jira issues come from.

operations.name: chooseProject
operations.label: Choose a Project's Jira project
operations.description: Choose which Jira project a Project shows the issues of.

cloudId.description: The cloud id of the Atlassian site the Jira project is on.

key.description: The Jira project's key, such as ARGO.

operations.name: forgetProject
operations.label: Choose another Jira project
operations.description: Forget a Project's Jira project, so the page asks which one to show again.

operations.name: checkAgain
operations.label: Read Jira again
operations.description: Make the Jira pages read Jira again.

capabilities.reason: Reads and changes Jira issues as the signed-in person.
Finds your Atlassian site's cloud id at <site>.atlassian.net, and tells an unscoped API token from a wrong one. The Plugin calls only *.atlassian.net hosts this way.
